connector.name: Amicus
connector.registryDescription: Multi-model LLM Council and parallel AI window for Claude Code. Fork any model, fold results back.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package amicus. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bourbondog account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
env.description: OpenRouter API key (recommended multi-model route). Optional when a provider key is configured via 'amicus setup' (~/.config/amicus/.env) or OpenCode auth.json.

env.name: AMICUS_SKIP_POSTINSTALL
env.description: Set to 1 when a plugin/client manages registration itself (skips npm postinstall side effects).
